d:
The 3rd Tentacle Travelers set from Nado.E. It's once more focused on Tamaki, and once more does that Fighter/Paladin split. It's more annoying this time around because the last section of the set doesn't have that difference (because she's naked), so it creates some doubling up (which was annoying to deal with because of how e-hentai handles some things)... but oh well. Still hot and all that jazz. Weirdly enough, there was no cover pic in the DL itself, so I had to get it off of dlsite.

In any case, support the artist if you can. The art-style is great and it has the potential to become even better as more stuff comes out.
